message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2 variant) in Europeans**

| Source | Population | Allele frequency (C allele) |
|--------|------------|------------------------------|
| **gnomAD v2.1.1** (Exome & Genome) | Non-Finnish European (NFE) | **≈ 0.07 – 0.08** |
| **1000 Genomes Project** (Phase 3) | European (EUR) | **≈ 0.07** |
| **UK Biobank** (European ancestry) | UK Europeans | **≈ 0.07** |

> **Interpretation**  
> The C allele at rs7412 corresponds to the APOE ε2 allele. In most European populations it occurs at roughly 7 % of chromosomes (≈ 1 in 14). The frequency is fairly stable across Western, Central, and Southern European subgroups, but can be slightly lower (~5 %) in some Northern European or Finnish cohorts.

### Quick reference

- **gnomAD**: https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/rs7412  
- **1000 Genomes**: https://www.internationalgenome.org/data-portal/variant/rs7412  
- **UK Biobank**: https://biobank.ctsu.ox.ac.uk/crystal/variant_summary.php?variant=rs7412

If you need the exact count or a more granular breakdown (e.g., by country or ancestry group), let me know and I can pull the latest numbers from the respective databases.
